after.description: NGINX Open Source and NGINX Plus have a vulnerability in the ngx_http_mp4_module, which might allow an attacker to over-read NGINX worker memory resulting in its termination, using a specially crafted mp4 file. The issue only affects NGINX if it is built with the ngx_http_mp4_module and the mp4 directive is used in the configuration file. Additionally, the attack is possible only if an attacker can trigger the processing of a specially crafted mp4 file with the ngx_http_mp4_module.  Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

after.documented_configuration_context:
NGINX Open Source and NGINX Plus have a vulnerability in the ngx_http_mp4_module, which might allow an attacker to over-read NGINX worker memory resulting in its termination, using a specially crafted mp4 file. The issue only affects NGINX if it is built with the ngx_http_mp4_module and the mp4 directive is used in the configuration file. Additionally, the attack is possible only if an attacker can trigger the processing of a specially crafted mp4 file with the ngx_http_mp4_module.  Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

Thông báo upstream bổ sung:
A security issue was identified in the ngx_http_mp4_module, which might allow an attacker to cause a worker process crash by using a specially crafted mp4 file (CVE-2024-7347). The issue only affects nginx if it is built with the ngx_http_mp4_module (the module is not built by default) and the “mp4” directive is used in the configuration file. Further, the attack is only possible if an attacker is able to trigger processing of a specially crafted mp4 file with the ngx_http_mp4_module.
 
The issue affects nginx 1.5.13+.
The issue is fixed in 1.27.1, 1.26.2.
 
Patch for the issue can be found here: https://nginx.org/download/patch.2024.mp4.txt Thanks to Nils Bars for the initial report.

after.name: CVE-2024-7347
after.normal_component_behavior: Hỗ trợ streaming nội dung MP4 với xử lý metadata của media. Module được kích hoạt theo build và directive, không mặc nhiên tồn tại trong mọi deployment.
after.potential_impact: Nguồn đã thu thập chưa cung cấp đủ thông tin; cần rà soát thủ công.
after.remediation_limitations: Fixed release chỉ nói về CVE này, không bảo đảm release còn được hỗ trợ hoặc đã sửa mọi CVE.
after.root_cause_summary:
Nguồn phân loại vấn đề: Buffer overread in the ngx_http_mp4_module.

CWE-126 — Buffer Over-read: Đọc tiếp qua cuối buffer chứa dữ liệu.

Đây là giải thích lớp lỗi theo CWE mà CNA gán, không phải kết luận về dòng mã gây lỗi. Chưa có source-code root cause review độc lập.
after.security_assumption_violated: Parser theo dõi số byte còn lại, không dùng sentinel ngoài vùng hợp lệ.
after.security_boundary: Ranh giới bộ nhớ, trạng thái hoặc quyền của phần mềm xử lý dữ liệu không tin cậy.
